title: ECSS-E-ST-40C Rev.1, Space engineering: Software
body: The engineering standard the package follows: the requirements baseline (5.2), the technical specification (5.4), the design (5.5), the validation (5.6), the delivery and acceptance (5.7), the verification (5.8) and the DRDs of its annexes. Cited, never copied.
rationale: The documents' structure and the reviews' contents.

title: ECSS-Q-ST-80C Rev.2, Space product assurance: Software product assurance
body: The product assurance standard: the software criticality categories (6.2.2) the tailoring argues from. Cited, never copied.
rationale: The category and its consequences on the activities.

title: ISO/IEC 9899:2011, 7.17 Atomics
body: The C11 memory model: atomic objects, memory_order_relaxed, memory_order_acquire and memory_order_release, the synchronizes-with relation, atomic_is_lock_free and the ATOMIC_*_LOCK_FREE macros.
rationale: The words in which the ordering requirements are stated and inspected.

title: Lamport, Specifying Concurrent Program Modules (1983)
body: L. Lamport, Specifying Concurrent Program Modules, ACM Transactions on Programming Languages and Systems 5(2), 1983: the bounded single-producer single-consumer queue that needs no lock, each index written by one side only.
rationale: The algorithm SPSCring implements, with C11 acquire and release in place of the sequential consistency the paper assumes.

title: Herlihy, Wait-free synchronization (1991)
body: M. Herlihy, Wait-free synchronization, ACM Transactions on Programming Languages and Systems 13(1), 1991: wait-freedom, every call finishing in a bounded number of its own steps whatever the other threads do.

title: The repository's README at 1.0.8
body: README.md of SPSCring at 0ad84dc1: the API contract, the implementation choices, the lock-free target support, the index width, the build, the tests, the release process.
rationale: The supplier's own statement of its contract, read against the header and the code.

title: kyr_host 1.5.0, the customer's use
body: kyr_host at f69df7a7 (v1.5.0), the platform's host: the listener's hand-off to the least loaded operator, the operator's ring, its drain on wake-up, the ring's capacity from KYR_HOST_RING_CAPACITY, the reject slot when no operator can take a connection.
rationale: Where the requirements baseline comes from: the customer's code.
